title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.76
exact_target: Can an irreducible elementary net over an odd-characteristic field be closed under generated transvections while admitting no compatible diagonal completion?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2585 (KOU-21.76). CC BY 4.0.

V. A. Koibaev, Problem 21.76, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). See also source definitions in Problems 19.48. This version records an affirmative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
